a: A primary key uniquely identifies each row in a table.
A foreign key references a primary key in another table to link related rows.
Normalization organizes tables to reduce duplication and improve integrity.
Denormalization adds controlled duplication for faster reads at the cost of write complexity.
INNER JOIN returns only rows that match in both tables.
A transaction groups statements so they all commit or all roll back together.
ACID means Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability — properties of reliable databases.
An ORM maps objects in code to database tables (e.g. SQLAlchemy, Prisma, Django ORM).
A migration is a versioned change to the database schema.
An index speeds up lookups on columns at the cost of extra storage and slower writes.
The N+1 problem runs one query plus one per row. Fix with joins or eager loading.
A connection pool reuses DB connections so apps do not open a new one per request.
NoSQL databases store data as documents, key-value, wide-column, or graphs instead of only tables.
Redis is often used for caching, sessions, rate limits, and real-time leaderboards.
